name: Kyoritsu Electric India Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Kyoritsu Electric India is a 100% subsidiary focused on providing cost-effective SMT and PCBA testing solutions, aligning with the 'Make in India' initiative.
summary: Kyoritsu Electric India specializes in providing end-to-end solutions for SMT manufacturing and PCBA testing, including in-circuit testers and function test jigs. They support semiconductor backend manufacturing with advanced packaging technologies and precision engineering solutions.
